notes.title: Wait - 2.0 Update
notes.notes:
For its 9 year anniversary, and in preparation for the release of 'Wait: The Patient', we updated 'Wait' to version 2.0, with lots of changes and improvements. 
If you are currently in the middle of a playthrough, it is safer to start the playthrough from the beginning, but it's not a necessity.

2.0 Changelog:

Presentation:

 Most ingame illustrations have been overhauled
 Title screen artworks have been overhauled
 Added voice for the audio logs you can find
 Added a day cycle animation
 Certain dialogue texts have been colored in for better character distinction
 Adjusted some SFX volumes
 Added atmopheric background noise in certain areas


Features:

 Added an item overview that can be opened actively, and removed the item images on the side of the screen. 
 Added item illustrations for almost all items for that purpose.
 Disabled the infamous F12 key, that would restart your game immediately.


Game Flow:

 Removed the possibility of getting a different ending in the 1st playthrough, which led to some confusion and frustration.
 Changed the story flow in the 3rd night of the 2nd playthrough for more clarity.
 Added a new artwork to the chase in the 2nd night of the 1st playthrough.


Bug Fixes:

 Fixed a bug that made it impossible to put the small lamp back in Riley's Basement.
 Added some missing text in the German version.
 Changed an event that would display German text in the French version, on the second interaction.
 Changed French text in the 3rd night of the 4th playthrough that was displayed in German.
 Fixed some typos in the English version,
 Fixed a bug where, under certain conditions, a wrong item would be given to the player.


We hope you enjoy the update and as always, feel free to join our Discord if you have any questions or feedback or issues: 
rest.less Games Discord Server

notes.title: Demo Release and development update
notes.notes:
Demo Release

Today we released a playable demo of 'Wait - Extended' that let's you play through the first nights of the main story. The demo version is already in version 2.0 which features some new artwork and some quality of life improvements. That being said, the full game still remains in v1.8, just to clear up any confusion should you play the full game after having played the demo. 

So, if you were uncertain about purchasing the game up until now, we invite you to play the demo and see for yourself if it's something for you. 
You can find it on the store page of the full game.

Development of 2.0

As for the development of 2.0 'The Patient', we are nearing its end. While we said Q1 in our teaser, due to private matters, it didn't work out and we apologize. 
The story of the new side story has been completely developed and now we are implementing all sorts of polishing and extra elements that are still open, such as some optional side quests and secrets, as well as the artwork overhaul for the main story. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10539605/af9d92a2ce914c607e2244a1c56d32310271164b.png

We hope you are as excited for it as we are and stay tuned.

notes.title: Development Update and RPG Maker Festival
notes.notes:
Hello, 

here's a very late "first update of the year". 

RPG Maker Festival 2024

Before we dive into the current development, the RPG Maker Festival 2024 has started and we are participating with 'Wait - Extended'. So if you want to check out the game before the big update, you could get it now for a small discount. 
We also encourage you to check out the other great games participating in the festval.

RPG Maker Festival 2024


Development

As for the development of 'The Patient' and version 2.0, we have finished almost all of the illustrations for the cutscenes and will start voice recording for the protagonist this week. We're very excited to put the visuals and audio together and eventually show you the results. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10539605/8d4d57c70da0bbe839ed61e91c7c57da24c9e259.png

As part of the update, the artwork from the base game will also be overhauled with the new style, which we will start, after all artwork for 'The Patient' has been created. 

On the coding side, we are trying to find a good fix for the infamous F12 key that, per engine default, restarts the game, instead of taking a Steam screenshot. Since this requires making changes to the core system, we're being very cautious with the whole plan. The last thing we want is to break what's already there.

As for the gameplay, sadly the game flow implementation isn't finished yet. The beginning of the year was wild and didn't leave as much time for development, as we had hoped. We are still aiming for our Q1 goal, though. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10539605/83b1278b74c791803f903f983197102fa92842af.jpg

A final note

Lastly, a little request - we're a very small passion driven team and although passion is an important factor when making games, it doesn't help if no one knows about your game. Marketing a game these days is like chewing on a tough piece of meat, and if you like our game and what we do, we'd like to kindly ask for your assistance in this regard. Share the trailer, our Steam page, our Discord with people you think are into that kind of game. Everything helps us get a little more traction. 

Thank you. 

rest.less Games YouTube

rest.less Games Discord

notes.title: About release dates and teasers
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, 

we've been working a lot on the scarier parts of the new content, drawing inspiration from other incredible games (especially old ones), while trying to stay true to the way we convey horror in the base game (no jump scares, only atmosphere). 

By now, it is easier to evaluate when we'll be done and while we cannot give you a specific date yet, we can definitely say it is going to be some time in Q1 of 2024 (therefore soon-ish). 

To give you a bit of a taste of what you can expect from 'The Patient', we prepared this short teaser. We hope you enjoy and if you do, wishlist or purchase the game on Steam and join our Discord. 

[previewyoutube=tIl74OcMdJU;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: More info on the Wait 2.0 Update 'The Patient'
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10539605/1f8316988d669ec9b78881628f3651c444e1a998.png

As promised, here is some more info on the Wait - Extended v2.0 update called 'The Patient'. 
The biggest addition of this update is a completely new sidestory with the same name that can be started directly from the title menu.
To unlock 'The Patient', you must have at least played through the first invocation (first playthrough) of the main story. 
That being said, playing more invocations after that may help to better grasp the experience of this new sidestory.

'The Patient' will take place in the 90s and will feature a new protagonist. 

We will gradually release more information about the sidestory as well as updates to the base game. 
If you have questions or want to talk to us, feel free to join our Discord: 
rest.less Games Discord

notes.title: Mini Update 1.8 - Volume Control and other small changes
notes.notes:
Mini Update 1.8
- Added a volume control point, accessible from the Esc-menu.
- Changed the way to progress in the 2nd invocation, making sure players reach the necessary solution. (This cryptic description is to avoid spoilers for new players.) This particular issue has been a leftover flaw that derived from an old game design idea that we eventually threw away and we really felt like finally adjusting this. 
- Fixed some minor typos.
- Preparing for v2.0

notes.title: Patch 1.8 for Wait - Extended is online
notes.notes:
Greetings, we just released a new patch for Wait. 

Change notes v1.8:

- Fixed a major exploit in the fifth night of the 2nd invocation. Luckily no one noticed it yet (or maybe someone has, but didn't tell us. Shame on you!)

- Fixed a few minor bugs in general.

- Added more interaction variety in Emilys Sidestory. We felt like too many objects had the same text throughout her story. Now there's a greater variety of texts during her first night and second day.
